nodes.label: ROE & ROCE Screen Fixture — Page 1
nodes.author: Mittal Analytics Private Limited
nodes.rationale: A real 42KB capture of screener.in's public 'ROE & ROCE' screen, page 1, 25 data rows. It exists because SCREENER_COLUMNS was written from imagination and parsed zero real rows — the parser is now driven by a real page rather than a hypothesis about one.

nodes.label: Screener Screen Table Markup Contract
nodes.rationale: Rows are identified by data-row-company-id and columns by a th data-tooltip attribute (Current Price, Price to Earning, Market Capitalization, Dividend yield, Net Profit latest quarter, YOY Quarterly profit growth, Sales latest quarter, YOY Quarterly sales growth, Return on capital employed, Return on equity, Average return on equity 3Years/5Years). Some owner screens render tooltip-less headers, which is why normalizeHeader needs a visible-text alias path; the company link slug is the only identity screener exports, since it publishes no ticker.
